# FirmwareLiberator

> Converts Sonoff smart devices from their stock eWeLink firmware to Tasmota, ESPHome or OpenBeken over Wi-Fi: no soldering and no opening the device. Free and open source, it runs on Linux, macOS and Windows and walks you through every step.

The front page has the current list of supported devices, and the one line to paste into a terminal to start, for each system.

## Start here

- [Front page](https://firmwareliberator.com/): what the tool does, what you need, and the one line that starts it
- [What happens](https://firmwareliberator.com/docs/what-happens): each stage of a conversion, for someone deciding whether to run one
- [Troubleshooting](https://firmwareliberator.com/docs/troubleshooting): problems met in practice, and their fixes

## After converting

- [Home Assistant adoption](https://firmwareliberator.com/docs/home-assistant-adoption): adding a plug converted to ESPHome to Home Assistant
- [Updating firmware](https://firmwareliberator.com/docs/updating-firmware): keeping a converted plug's firmware up to date

## Devices

- [Sonoff S60](https://firmwareliberator.com/devices/sonoff-s60): the ESP32-C3 plug
- [Sonoff S61](https://firmwareliberator.com/devices/sonoff-s61): the Beken BK7238 plug

## Optional

- [Technical details](https://firmwareliberator.com/docs/technical-details): how the conversion works
- [Legal](https://firmwareliberator.com/docs/legal): backing up and replacing the firmware of a plug you own
- [Changelog](https://firmwareliberator.com/CHANGELOG): the tool's versions
- [Source code and releases](https://github.com/adamsthws/firmware-liberator): the repository on GitHub
